identity.title: Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game!

leadText:
----
 
(Japanese: Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game!) is a one-shot by Ryū Matsushima based on the Pokémon Trading Card Game. It was published in an extra book of the CoroCoro Ichiban! March 2013 issue titled (Japanese: Pokémon Card Game BW: Team Plasma All-Out Assault Book), released on January 21, 2013. It is followed by Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game XY!. It is 14 pages long.
